disclaimer: EXPLORATORY PRECLINICAL IN SILICO BENCHMARK (NON-REGULATORY). All co-folded 3D complexes, confidence scores (pLDDT/PAE/ipTM), affinity estimates, and 7-axis PoseRealityAuditor reports generated by NanoFold3 are computational research outputs intended solely for methodology evaluation and hypothesis prioritization. They do NOT constitute experimental structural biology, validated binding affinity measurements, or clinical/regulatory evidence, and require orthogonal experimental verification (e.g., X-ray crystallography / cryo-EM, biochemical binding assays, and GLP safety testing) prior to any translational decision.
honest_caveats: Compact nano-scale budget: trained NanoFold3 preset='nano' (~1.43-1.65M params) on 181 real LP-PDBBind complexes for 16 epochs (1181.5s total on Apple M3 Pro MPS). This validates end-to-end differentiable learning and architecture trade-offs, NOT frontier PDB-scale AlphaFold 3 / Boltz-2 accuracy (which require ~100M+ parameters and >100k structures).

Raw unrelaxed diffusion coordinates vs. strict PoseBusters covalent tolerances: without post-sampling MMFF94s/RDKit geometry relaxation, a 1.5M-param all-atom denoiser trained for 16 epochs exhibits residual covalent bond/angle errors that cause strict PoseBusters Axis-1 failures even when global ligand placement and Smooth LDDT improve substantially over untrained baselines.

Confidence calibration at small sample/epoch budget: pLDDT and ipTM Spearman correlations vs. held-out RMSD are reported honestly with exact p-values; reliable confidence calibration typically requires multi-stage fine-tuning (AF3 Stage 3) over thousands of diverse complexes after coordinate convergence.

External CLI backends (Boltz-2, Protenix, AlphaFold 3) were verified for strict offline input-schema emission and round-trip parsing on human DRD2 (6CM4); live external CLI structure prediction was not executed because external weights are not bundled in this offline workspace.

dataset_and_leakage_audit.split_protocol: LP-PDBBind protein-cluster split + strict post-filtering removing any PDB ID, exact protein sequence, canonical isomeric SMILES, or CNS target-family overlap across train, val, test, and human CNS evaluation pockets.
dataset_and_leakage_audit.featurization_leak_guard: Pocket-centroid frame origin (pocket_center=None, zero ligand coordinate input); ligand 52-D features, covalent adjacency, and ideal 1-2/1-3 bond lengths computed from fresh RDKit ETKDGv3+MMFF94s conformers; crystal coordinates used solely as supervision targets during training and evaluation ground truth.
